answer: A fable of free identities collapses when forging ten thousand wallets costs ten thousand bonds plus slashing risk on any provable duplicate behavior. Sybil resistance via stake-and-slash bonding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation before voting. Like a plume caught in wind, fake accounts scatter once real capital is at stake, and legitimate agents crossing the jetty into the economy pay only a refundable deposit, making attack cost exceed any reward. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
